summary: End-to-end verification of CCDP CRM: 13/13 backend pytest cases passed and the complete admin + public resource inquiry flow was validated in the browser against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Everything in the review request works as specified. Emails and Google Sheets remain intentionally gated (emailEnabled=false, sheetsEnabled=false) as expected.

minor.issue: In-memory rate limit dict (_RATE) grows unbounded per IP with no eviction beyond the rolling window read; low priority but flag for prod.

Upsert-by-email replaces entire doc using $set from new payload — this overwrites message/source/organization of the previous submission (verified: TEST_ Org A -> TEST_ Org B). This IS the documented CRM behavior per test_credentials.md, but if E1 later wants to preserve prior message history, consider appending instead of overwriting.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py get_current_admin has bare `except Exception:` inside verify_password — fine, but consider narrowing.
inquiries.py: rate limit is in-memory (dies with worker restart, ineffective under multiple workers). Acceptable for MVP but should move to Redis/DB for production.
server.py still contains legacy StatusCheck routes — unused for this CRM feature, harmless but could be removed for tidiness.

AdminInquiries.jsx: `detail-last` and `detail-next` fire patch on every onChange keystroke of a date input — Chrome only fires onChange when a valid date is selected so it's OK in practice, but consider onBlur for consistency with assignedTo/notes.
InquiryDialog: honeypot input uses `absolute left-[-9999px]` — fine, but a screen reader may still tab into it; aria-hidden is set which mitigates.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed inquiries created by pytest + one UI-submitted inquiry (ui_test_1783216001@example.com). Admin dashboard reported stat-total=5 during UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are parallel-safe (xdist). Public inquiries POST is rate-limited to 6/15min per IP — if tests + UI runs both hit the same forwarded-for IP, add sleeps or wait for reset. Emails are gated (RESEND_API_KEY empty) and Sheets are gated (GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON empty) — do NOT report those as bugs.
verified_flows: POST /api/inquiries success + honeypot silently accepted (no store) + 422 on invalid/missing fields + upsert-by-email keeps one doc
GET /api/admin/inquiries/export returns text/csv with header row incl. 'Inquiry ID','Date Submitted','Organization'; respects filters
UI: /resources -> resource-btn-res_degree opens dialog with areaOfInterest prefilled 'Degree Program'; submit shows inquiry-success
UI: /admin/inquiries redirects to /admin/login when logged out; login -> dashboard with stat-total, filter-status, admin-search all work
UI: inquiry-row click opens inquiry-detail; detail-status Radix select, detail-assigned onBlur, detail-notes onBlur, detail-last/next date inputs, mark-followup-btn all trigger PATCH successfully
UI: export-filtered-btn and export-all-btn both trigger CSV download; admin-logout-btn returns to /admin/login
